subject: scripts/blocknote-dependencies.test.mjs
because: BlockNote was the old editor's library. scripts/no-editor-view-framework.test.mjs replaces this check: it fires on BlockNote, Tiptap, ProseMirror view and Yjs in the new Paper packs, and it widens to the whole repo when the old packages and their dependencies are removed.

subject: scripts/paper-measured-pagination.test.mjs
because: It checks how the old rich editor tiles page backgrounds with a repeating gradient. The new editor paints each page as its own box in painter.ts, so there is no tiled background to check and no replacement is needed.

subject: scripts/guard-ledger/paper-measured-pagination.json
because: Ledger row of the retired paper-measured-pagination check; its historic mistake lives in old rich editor code.

subject: scripts/paper-page-layout.test.mjs

subject: scripts/guard-ledger/paper-page-layout.json

subject: scripts/paper-blank-canvas.test.mjs
because: Retargeted to the new Paper. The blank rule stays and now checks emptyPaper, blankCv and blankLetter from paperEngineBlank, the startingPage creation path with a mistake fixture, and the bytes of the new Word writer for a blank. The cases on emptyRichPaper and the old canvas mint checked only old engine code.

subject: scripts/paper-page-scale.test.mjs
because: Retargeted to the new Paper editor. The rule that the page is the same on every screen stays and now checks paper-editor.css, paper-editor.ts and painter.ts, with a mistake fixture that puts a reflow into fit(). The old Word canvas, its border space and the lazy rich editor boundary cases checked files that are gone or only used by old engine code.

subject: scripts/guard-ledger/paper-page-scale.json
because: The guard now scopes to the new editor, so the historic reflow in the old rich-page-layout.ts is out of scope. The row records why, and the test injects the same reflow into the current fit() of paper-editor.ts, where it fires.
